production.note: US model years. Start: Ford's 2013 Focus brochure includes the Focus ST; Ford opened US orders on May 1, 2012 (source ford-focus-st-order-release-2012). End: Ford's 2018 Focus brochure still lists the ST with "252 hp @ 5,500 rpm" and the "6-speed manual" (source ford-us-focus-brochure-2018); auto-brochures.com lists no US Focus brochure after 2018, and Ford Authority says the third-generation Focus "has already ended production in North America" (source fordauthority-focus). No opened Ford page says in so many words that 2018 was the last model year.

body.note: Sold in the US only as the five-door hatchback ("ST Hatchback"). The Auto Channel: "transverse front engine, front-wheel drive" (source autochannel-focus-st-2013).

displacementL.note: The Auto Channel's specifications: "2.0 liters / 122 cu. in." No opened page gives the exact cc figure.

fuel.note: Brochure horsepower footnote: "Figures achieved using premium unleaded fuel".

transmission.note: "6-speed manual transmission". Automotive Addicts: "6-speed manual transmission, the only one offered on the new 2013 Focus ST" (source automotiveaddicts-focus-st-2013). The 2018 brochure also lists only the 6-speed manual for the ST.

powerHp.note: Quote, Ford release of May 1, 2012: "SAE-certified at 252 horsepower and 270 lb.-ft. of torque from efficient 2.0-liter EcoBoost® engine". Ford's 2013 brochure: "252 @ 5,500 rpm" (footnote: "Figures achieved using premium unleaded fuel"); the 2018 brochure: "252 hp @ 5,500 rpm", so the rating did not change over the run.

weightLb.note: No Ford curb weight could be opened, so this rests on publications (weight step 2: the same figure from two independent outlets with named authors). Quote, The Auto Channel, Carey Russ, May 30, 2013, 2013 Focus ST specifications: "Curb Weight 3223 lbs." Quote, Carpages.ca, Dan Heyman, July 8, 2013, "2013 Ford Focus ST – Specifications": "Curb weight: 1,462 kg (3,223 lbs.)" (source carpages-focus-st-2013; a Canadian outlet reviewing the same car). The Associated Press fact sheet for the 2014 Focus ST also gives "CURB WEIGHT: 3,223 pounds." (source ap-focus-st-2014). The only transmission is the 6-speed manual. See discrepancies. The Auto Channel's figure is for a US car; Carpages.ca reviews the Canadian car, which shares the US specification; the Associated Press US fact sheet for the 2014 car (no named author) also gives 'CURB WEIGHT: 3,223 pounds.'

discrepancies.reason: Automotive Addicts' review (Malcolm Hogan, January 2013) prints "Curb weight: 3,150lbs." for the same car, with no stated basis. Three other outlets (The Auto Channel, Carpages.ca, The Associated Press) independently print 3,223 lb.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,223 lb, the figure two independent outlets with named authors agree on and the AP fact sheet repeats; 3,150 lb is a lone, unexplained figure.
